notes: conranshop.co.uk redirects to theconranshop.com (Shopify platform, standard robots.txt, no Claude-specific disallow, no full-site block) - worked entirely via direct HTTP fetch, no Playwright/Chrome needed. Also checked the pages sitemap (sitemap_pages_1.xml) - only 'spring-offers' relates to seasonality and it is a generic sale/offers page, not a holiday-specific product category, so excluded per the storewide-sale rule. Confirmed via homepage nav link extraction (all /collections/* hrefs on the homepage) - no seasonal terms appear anywhere in nav text or link slugs; only gift-adjacent collections exist (gifts, gifts-under-30, gifts-under-50, gifts-under-100, luxury-gifts) which are price/occasion-agnostic gift collections, not holiday categories. Probed common seasonal slugs directly (christmas, holiday-shop, festive, gifting, christmas-decorations, christmas-shop, seasonal, easter, halloween, valentines-day) - all 404 except /collections/christmas, which returns HTTP 200 but is a redirect (effective URL https://theconranshop.com/collections/gifts) landing on the generic Gifts collection with no Christmas-specific content, framing, or filtering - not a genuine standalone PLP, so excluded. Final on-site search query for 'christmas' at /search?q=christmas&type=product returned 0 results, confirming no Christmas-tagged or Christmas-named products exist in the catalog at all. The Conran Shop is a UK design-led furniture/home retailer and, consistent with its brand focus, carries no dedicated seasonal/holiday decor line as of this pass (2026-09-04).
